hot_page.note: One compulsory page fault; repeated accesses should benefit from TLB reuse.

cold_stream.note: Twelve first-touch pages; a TLB cannot remove compulsory walks.

sequential_12.note: Twelve-page working set; compare miss frequency across TLB capacities.

same_set_4.note: Four pages with the same low-four-bit VPN index.

different_sets_4.note: Four pages in distinct low-four-bit VPN sets.

boundaries.note: Unaligned map and 4 KiB, 2 MiB, and 1 GiB crossings.

unmapped_access.note: Access outside mapped region should fail.

page_pressure.note: Fifteen unique pages force physical page replacement.
